items.title: MECH-294 behavioural falsifier re-run (measurement-window fix): contaminated_harm=0.0 closes self-contamination confound that starved V3-EXQ-840
items.note: Corrects V3-EXQ-840, which FAILed its readiness gate on all 3 packet-ON arms via adequate_committed_window_sample (worst-cell n_p1_ticks_past_window: JOINT=27, ALT=6, SHUF=92 vs floor=200). A prior failure_autopsy mischaracterised the cause as sub-floor joint_route_range_supra_floor (coherence routing) -- WRONG per direct manifest read (measured 0.063841 vs floor 0.01, ~6.4x headroom; recorded as diagnosis_correction on substrate_queue.json sd_id mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening, corrected_by_session confident-morse-af47a8). Per-cell data shows the SAME seeds (45, 49) starved EVERY arm including ARM_0_OFF (packet off entirely), ruling out packet-ON coherence routing as cause. Root physical cause: ENV_KWARGS declared a HARM-FREE env (num_hazards=0, hazard_harm=0.0, proximity_harm_scale=0.0) but left contaminated_harm at its 0.4 default -- self-contamination (agent revisiting its own trail) is not gated by num_hazards and drained agent_health for those seeds, triggering early episode termination well before the 200-step episode budget. FIX: contaminated_harm=0.0 closes the last health-depletion route (causal_grid_world.py's step() only ends an episode from agent_health<=0 or steps>=500; with hazard cells absent and all harm scales zeroed, that can never fire within a 200-step episode), so every cell now deterministically gets the full NOMINAL_WINDOW_TICKS=3600, ~18x the floor, for every seed. Applied identically across all 4 arms (env-level parameter, not routed through binding mode) so it cannot bias C1/C2; does NOT touch compose_per_candidate_coherence or the route-range readiness floor (both confirmed working correctly by the diagnosis). Preferred over inflating STEPS_PER_EPISODE/P1_MEASUREMENT_EPISODES: that adds compute without removing the confound and stays probabilistic rather than deterministic. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (committed-action-class TV across joint/alt/shuffled with per-candidate coherence routed) checked against V3-EXQ-840 itself -- NOT recoverable (that run self-routed substrate_not_ready_requeue on an inadequate sample) -- run. Smoke 2026-07-31: all 4 arms build+route+PASS at dry-run scale, no crash; validate_experiments.py --strict clean. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b) reviewed: validate_queue flags a WARN citing 2 counted substrate_ceiling/non_contributory MECH-294 autopsies (failure_autopsy_569f-661-654a_2026-06-10, about the pre-2026-06-19 SCALAR-coherence defect since fixed by the per-candidate amend; failure_autopsy_batch-687a-707c-840-748a-833-842-810b-673-614-798afail_2026-07-30, whose own recommended_epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect -- it counted only because its recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=create had not yet been corrected). EXEMPT: this is not a same-granularity re-test of a substrate ceiling -- the diagnosis_correction on substrate_queue.json sd_id mech294_coherence_magnitude_strengthening already established the named upstream substrate is diagnosis_corrected_no_substrate_defect (no build owed; route-range readiness independently confirmed MET at 6.4x floor). This queue entry repairs the EXPERIMENT measurement instrument, not the substrate. Follow-on chipped: correct the stale autopsy artifact action field to none/repair so the brake counter reflects this going forward.

items.title: MECH-324 rapid-reacquisition falsifier RE-RUN: reacquisition-window isolation fix (supersedes 829)
items.note: Validation for IGW-20260731-196 (/implement-substrate MECH-324/MECH-323 reacquisition-window isolation fix; design doc REE_assembly/docs/architecture/mech324_reacquisition_window_isolation.md). V3-EXQ-829 (ree-v3 77e3ddc) FALSIFIED rapid reacquisition: median_r_reacq flat at 90 (W=100) / 28 (W=30) across every tested f_reacq, r_reacq/window_trials = 0.908 +/- 0.029 -- the revival gate's variance/mean readout came from the accumulator's whole-lifetime tally, saturated at dissolution with the contaminating stream, so clearing the variance gate tracked window_trials, not the reacquisition_repetition_factor bar. FIX: new sub-switch use_reacquisition_window_isolation (default False, nested under use_chunk_dissolution_retention) routes the revival gate through a dedicated per-chunk window (ChunkedPrimitive.reacquisition_outcomes) populated only from real post-dissolution executions. This run adds the flag as a THIRD ablation axis (ISOON/ISOOFF) crossed with 829's EXACT f_reacq sweep {1.0,0.5,0.25,0.1} and window_trials {30,100} -- the ISOOFF arms are the direct apples-to-apples reproduction of 829's own measurement (in-run negative control, not a separate claim), the ISOON arms are the corrected substrate under test. Same seeds as 829 (11,23,37,43,59,71) for direct comparability. Load-bearing C1/C2/C3 now read the ISOON default arm (unchanged thresholds: SCALING_RHO_FLOOR=0.8, R_MIN=20); C4 (ISOON short-window), C5 (paired ISOON-vs-ISOOFF direct comparison), C6 (ISOOFF reproduces 829's flat signature) are reported, non-gating. Dropped 829's MILD-dissolution arm (C5 there) to bound this run's grid to 18 arms x 6 seeds = 108 cells -- orthogonal to the isolation question and already confirmed non-artifactual by 829 itself; a successor may re-add it if an isolation x dissolution-stream interaction becomes a live question. GOV-REUSE-1: 829's cells fingerprinted with the DEFAULT include_driver_script_in_hash=True (829's own docstring: deliberate refuse-by-default), so a different driver can never match regardless of config -- checked before authoring, not recoverable via try_reuse_cell, fresh run required. This run fingerprints the same way (pure-python operator cells, no reuse value). Precondition/readiness-gate machinery, DV-symmetry class, and OUTCOME_SPAN pre-registration are unchanged from 829 (isolation changes which window the two existing MECH-323 gates read, not the gates themselves or the driver's harness). Smoke --dry-run PASS (1 seed x 18 arms, all preconditions green, C1-C6 all True at n=1, rho_ISOON=1.0 exact, rho_ISOOFF=n/a correctly reproducing the flat/undefined-rank signature; validate_experiments.py --strict 0 findings incl. arm_fingerprint; progress instrumentation correct, ep N/1050 boundary prints + 18 verdict lines at n=1 -> 108 expected at n=6).

items.title: MECH-476 NOVELTY falsifier REDESIGN: noise-scaled margin + n=10 (supersedes 836c)
items.note: Redesign of V3-EXQ-836c per failure_autopsy_mech476-mech475-cluster_2026-07-29.md: 836c's reversed_novelty_effect verdict was driven entirely by ONE outlier seed in the unpaired arm (retained_fraction=2.767, 2-15x every sibling; arm SD 0.90 vs 0.33 for the paired arm) against a fixed 0.15 margin -- removing that seed flips the sign to weakly SUPPORT the paired-retains-more prediction, well inside the margin either way; did not survive a leave-one-out check. Fix (both applied): (1) novelty_retention_margin replaced with a noise-scaled floor max(EFFECT_SIZE_K=1.5 * sd_delta, EFFECT_SIZE_ABS_FLOOR=0.05), sd_delta = SD of the per-seed paired (paired-unpaired) retained_fraction delta, mirroring v3_exq_824a's convention (same K/ABS_FLOOR as the sibling 836a redesign for a consistent discrimination standard across MECH-476's arms); (2) seeds 6->10 per arm; (3) median reported alongside mean per arm; (4) in-line leave-one-out robustness diagnostic. User-confirmed routing via AskUserQuestion 2026-07-29 ("Redesign re-run (noise-scaled margin + more seeds)"). hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json qid=competence_floor hid=H-mech476-novelty-tagging left alive (836c uninformative, not falsifying). GOV-REUSE-1: the noise-scaled novelty-contrast verdict at n=10 is not recorded in any prior manifest -> must run. Re-derive brake: does not apply -- 836c's epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect (not substrate_ceiling) with recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=none. FLAG for V3-EXQ-836b's own eventual autopsy: 836b (still running as of this queueing, INTERVAL arm) uses the identical fixed RESISTANCE_INTERVAL_MARGIN=0.15 literal pattern (verified by direct grep) -- same discrimination-rule defect is very likely present there too; check before trusting any verdict from it. 836b is out of scope for this redesign chip and was not modified. Smoke PASS (validate_experiments.py --strict: 2 OK / 0 warnings; --dry-run runs end-to-end, both arms readiness-gated green on tiny dry-run doses, no crash).

items.title: MECH-476 INTERVAL falsifier REDESIGN: noise-scaled margin + n=10 (supersedes 836b)
items.note: Redesign of V3-EXQ-836b per failure_autopsy_v3-exq-836b_2026-07-29.md (REE_assembly 4cff1b73e8): 836b's non_monotone_interval_response verdict rested on a FIXED 0.15 margin not scaled to observed per-arm noise (per-arm SEMs 0.098-0.147 at n=6, comparable to the between-arm deltas [+0.147,+0.213,-0.157] the verdict was read from) and did not survive a leave-one-out check (the n400 peak was driven by one seed at retained_fraction=1.285 against siblings 0.202-0.934; dropping it pulls the mean 0.749->0.642, collapsing the non-monotone peak). Same measurement_test_design_defect as siblings 836 (dose) and 836c (novelty), both already redone under this rule (V3-EXQ-836a, V3-EXQ-836d) -- this queues the third and final leg of the family. Fix (both applied, IDENTICAL convention to 836a/836d): (1) RESISTANCE_INTERVAL_MARGIN replaced with a noise-scaled floor max(EFFECT_SIZE_K=1.5 * sd_delta, EFFECT_SIZE_ABS_FLOOR=0.05), sd_delta = SD of the per-seed paired (max_N-min_N) retained_fraction delta, mirroring v3_exq_824a's EFFECT_SIZE_K/ABS_FLOOR convention and matching the sibling redesigns' constants exactly for a consistent discrimination standard across MECH-476's three arms; (2) seeds 6->10 per arm (same seed tuple 42-51 as 836a/836d); (3) median reported alongside mean per arm; (4) in-line leave-one-out robustness diagnostic. STOP-CHECK / coordination (chip chip-20260729-836b-redo-noise-scaled): confirmed via experiment_queue.json + evidence/ search that 836a (dose redesign, status=claimed on ree-cloud-2 as of this queueing) and 836d (novelty redesign, supersedes 836c, status=pending) are ALREADY queued under this exact convention; neither has produced a manifest yet, so nothing here is reanalyzable from them (GOV-REUSE-1 checked -- each leg's decisive readout is leg-specific). This entry adopts the identical EFFECT_SIZE_K/ABS_FLOOR/seed-count/leave-one-out shape for cross-arm comparability. User-confirmed routing precedent: 836a/836d both cite AskUserQuestion 2026-07-29 ("Redesign re-run (noise-scaled margin + more seeds)") for the same MECH-476 family; this leg follows the same user-approved routing (failure_autopsy_v3-exq-836b_2026-07-29.md Section 7: "Routing: /queue-experiment -- 836b redo under a noise-scaled discrimination rule (same route the cluster gave 836/836c)"). GOV-REUSE-1: the noise-scaled interval-response verdict at n=10 is not recorded in any prior manifest (836b's own manifest computed it under the wrong rule and at n=6) -> must run. Re-derive brake: does not apply -- 836b's epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect (not substrate_ceiling) with recommended_substrate_queue_entry.action=none. Smoke PASS (validate_experiments.py --strict: 1 OK / 0 warnings; --dry-run runs end-to-end on 3 interval arms x 2 seeds toy scale, all arms readiness-gated green, correctly self-routes retention_invariant_to_interval_no_process at toy scale (spread=0.0 < effective floor 0.05), no crash; dry-run manifest written then cleaned up per the dry_run relocation contract, sentinel emitted).

items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-D (H4 diagnostic): context-conditioned (reef vs open) committed-class TV-divergence, ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF
items.note: arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-D (H4: measurement aliasing). chip chip-20260729-arc062-pd-context-modeswitch. DIAGNOSTIC, claim_ids=[] intentionally empty; brake-exempt (different question from the same-claim P-A retest). PREMISE CORRECTION vs Section 2's literal text (STOP-CHECK, this session): the plan doc's P-D design line names 'gated_policy routing', which Leg P-A's own erratum (same doc, appended 2026-07-31) found does NOT route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel -- modulatory_channel_route_source=gated_policy identity-routes the unrelated GatedPolicy module output (ree_core/agent.py:7414), not LateralPFCAnalog's rule_state. Since that routing would only add an unrelated equally-present-on-both-arms bias term (no bearing on a paired ARM_ON-vs-ARM_OFF comparison), THIS BUILD OMITS IT: script is a straight, code-verified adaptation of the already-run V3-EXQ-654j matched stack (unchanged: MECH-448 demotion + MECH-449 active No-Go both matched-stack constants; swept variable use_candidate_rule_field) plus a NEW context-partitioned readout on the same P2 window. Substrate verification (this session): SD-054 reef/open bipartite geometry is a real, already-used primitive (ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py, already in 654j's own ENV_KWARGS); _is_reef_half + _tv_distance ported verbatim from ree-v3/experiments/v3_exq_690_q054_arc062_diversity_floor_sweep.py, which demonstrates the partition is live and non-degenerate on this exact env config (seeds 42/43 both clear a >=10-tick floor in both partitions; seed 44 recorded 0 reef ticks under 690's DIFFERENT policy -- failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-690_2026-06-20.md). New C1g readiness gate (context_scorable on a majority of seeds, both arms) self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue if the partition is not exercisable under 654j's own policy, rather than assuming 690's finding transfers. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (paired-by-seed TV(committed-class|reef) vs TV(committed-class|open), ARM_ON vs ARM_OFF on the use_candidate_rule_field sweep) is not recorded anywhere -- V3-EXQ-690 already reports the same tv_reef_forage statistic per seed-arm but its swept variable is noise_floor_min_temperature, a different manipulation entirely; not recoverable by reanalysis, proceeds to a new run. DV-symmetry invariance declared in the script docstring: the CRF differentiation is not a broadcast scalar (inherits 654j's own established finding) and TV distance over set-aggregate categorical distributions carries no further arm-dependent symmetry. Declared null (H4 refuted): ARM_ON shows no greater cross-context divergence than ARM_OFF -> the pooled-marginal DV was not aliasing a context-switch; strengthens the H2/H3 reading over a measurement artifact. Declared positive (H4 confirmed): motivates a NEW evidence-purpose re-pose of MECH-309/ARC-062 with the context DV as primary (separate queue entry, not this one). Code review (this session): added a latch-clear (agent.e3.last_score_diagnostics=None immediately before every select_action) + n_latched_ticks counter for the inherited MECH-448/449 diagnostics reads, per the fanout doc's Section 2 preamble mandate and the V3-EXQ-785 ~9x pseudo-replication lesson -- clears validate_experiments.py's stale-e3-diagnostics and hold-weighted-readout WARNs (both present before the fix, both clear after; 654j itself still carries them uncorrected). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 non-conforming (1 pre-existing advisory anchor-reachability WARN, also present on the unmodified 654j template -- inherited, not new). --dry-run: both arms complete, verdict PASS x2, manifest written+cleaned; C1/C1g correctly read False on the tiny dry-run dose (2 P2 episodes x 30 steps cannot clear the readiness floors -- expected, matches 654j's own dry-run behaviour), confirming the code paths execute without error.

items.title: ARC-005 precision-only decoupled ladder: does the control plane route PRECISION, isolated from channels 3/4's occupancy-only authority? (successor to V3-EXQ-802)
items.note: Diagnosed this session (chip-20260731-arc005-802-precision-anomaly, documented in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_005_control_plane_routing_plan.md GAP-A-precision-diagnostic node): 802's joint 4-channel ladder required channels 3/4 (mode prior, pcc_stability -- never expected to touch precision, only occupancy per this plan doc's own channel table) to move precision alongside channels 1/2, diluting any real 1/2 signal with two channels structurally incapable of contributing. This experiment DECOUPLES: channels 1/2 laddered L0/L1/L2, channels 3/4 held FIXED at L0 in every cell. Also applies a real substrate bug fix landed this session (ree_core/agent.py SD-057 L7 dACC-consume block was reading get_world_state_sequence()[0,0,:], the collapsed proposer starting state identical across every candidate -- fixed by mirroring the existing ARC-065 GAP-A _candidate_world_summaries() pattern) via use_mech_consume=True + z_goal_enabled=True + candidate_summary_source='e2_world_forward', all new relative to 802. PRE-REGISTERED EXPECTATION (stated in the script's dv_symmetry_declaration): this run is expected to STILL show a near-zero null on all 10 units, for two separate already-diagnosed reasons -- channel 1's fixed wiring reaches a dacc_adapter network whose response magnitude is quantifiably negligible (~1e-8 vs ~0.87 scale of other score_bias components), consistent with the adapter never having trained on non-degenerate values of this input; channel 2 (phasic temperature) is architecturally argmax-invariant under REE's normal committed-selection regime (~97% commitment rate measured this session). A null here is a CLEAN, MECHANISTICALLY-EXPLAINED confirmation, not a surprise -- self-routes evidence_direction=non_contributory (never 'weakens' or 'mixed') when all 10 units land in the near-zero band, per the mandatory_design_check disposition for a DV-symmetry-invariant manipulation. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (precision monotonicity on a channel-1/2-ONLY ladder) does not exist in any recorded manifest -- 802 only ever varied all 4 channels together; not recoverable by reanalysis. Re-derive brake checked: 0 substrate_ceiling autopsies tag ARC-005 (one autopsy target exists, recommended_epistemic_category='standard', not a ceiling) -- not braked. TRACK B (channel 2 under an uncommitted/exploratory-only regime, the only way to let temperature matter) and TRACK C (retraining dacc_adapter on live goal_proximity) are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE here -- noted as candidate follow-on work, not built. Smoke --dry-run PASS (12 cells, 2 seeds x 3 levels x 2 contents at dry scale): all verdicts PASS, z_goal_stream active_frac=0.130 writer_calls=600 -- no writer defect (confirms the channel-1 fix's z_goal prerequisite is genuinely live), result already lands the pre-registered null pattern (all_near_zero_null=true, label=precision_channel_authority_null_expected) even at dry-run scale. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all checks.
items.supersedes_note: Not a lettered supersession of V3-EXQ-802 -- 802's C1/C3 occupancy result stands unchallenged. This is a new, precision-ONLY, decoupled-ladder design correcting 802's joint-ladder dilution confound on the precision DV specifically.

items.title: SD-036 GABAergic decay regulator: gaba_tone dose-response validation
items.note: SD-036's registered falsifier (design doc 'Predicted observables' #2), queued for the first time. SD-036 is `candidate` / v3_pending with ZERO experimental entries (exp_conf 0.0); this is the first run that can bear on it. UNBLOCKED BY ree-v3 35e8969 (2026-08-01T00:03Z): until the harm-stream decay RECURRENCE landed, LatentStack.encode() produced z_harm/z_harm_a as pure feedforward encodes, the regulator degenerated to a one-step constant rescale, and the scale-free DV harm_norm_sustain_ratio was EXACTLY invariant to gaba_tone (measured spread 8.6e-08 -- a structural null). Post-fix spread 1.4e-03 (z_harm) / 1.0e-01 (z_harm_a). DESIGN reused verbatim from the CATATONIA-II completion_note in psychiatric_failure_modes_plan.md: 2 trained agents per seed (decay-OFF vs decay-ON), then a set_gaba_tone() sweep over {0.3,0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0} on the trained ON agent, with use_pag_freeze_gate held OFF to de-confound from MECH-279 (which consumes gaba_tone as a direct scalar, never through the decay path -- so MECH-279 is NOT tagged and V3-EXQ-776's PASS is untouched). CONTROL ARM is use_gabaergic_decay=False, NOT gaba_tone=0.0: post-fix, tone 0.0 suspends decay but leaves the recurrence active, so tone 0.0 is no longer the legacy arm. PRIMARY DV is z_harm_a (sustain ratio mean/peak), not z_harm alone -- the z_harm effect is real but modest (spread 1.4e-03) vs z_harm_a (1.0e-01). DV-SYMMETRY (per arm, mandatory): the DV's symmetry group is POSITIVE SCALAR RESCALING (it is a ratio of one arm's own quantities) plus time-permutation. ARM_ON's manipulation (gaba_tone) is NOT invariant under either -- it changes the leaky-integrator pole (1-alpha)*exp(-tau*tone), altering the multiset of trajectory values, not their scale or order. ARM_OFF's manipulation is the master switch (structural), also not a rescale. This is measured, not assumed: a P0 positive control (fixed 60-step observation tape, fresh agents per tone) re-establishes non-invariance on the SAME statistic C1 routes on (the tone-spread) before any verdict is read, and self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue + non_degenerate=false below floor rather than reporting a refutation. Smoke measured control spread 9.1e-02 vs a 1e-3 floor. OBSERVABLE #1 IS EXPLICITLY NOT LOAD-BEARING: harm_encoder(zeros) norm ~0.46 and affective_harm_encoder(zeros,zeros) ~0.33, so the V3-EXQ-471 lock is substantially an ENCODER FLOOR response to the ambient hazard field, not pure temporal persistence; decay reaches an equilibrium against that floor rather than returning to baseline. The floor is measured and recorded every run and stated as the null; C3 is the floor-robust relative (ON-vs-OFF) form. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout is the gaba_tone dose-response on harm_a_sustain_ratio. reanalysis_query for harm_norm_sustain_ratio returned 0 matching manifests; the only prior SD-036 evidence is v3_exq_475 (2026-04-22, non_contributory -- voided by the update_z_goal TypeError contamination AND pre-dating the recurrence fix), and V3-EXQ-475a never produced a manifest. No compatible substrate_hash exists (pre-2026-07-12 manifests carry none, and the substrate changed on 2026-07-31 regardless) -> not recoverable, run. LINEAGE: not a lettered iteration of 475/475a -- new number because the design differs materially (475a bundled PAG ON with the gaba arm, which is exactly the confound this de-confounds). Re-derive brake: 0 counted autopsies on SD-036/SD-010/SD-011/MECH-279. MINT: first of the sd036_decay lineage; OFF arm factored into experiments/_lib/baselines/sd036_decay.py and emitted with include_driver_script_in_hash=False so a later different-driver sibling can reuse it. validate_experiments.py --strict: 1 OK, 0 warnings. --dry-run smoke PASS end-to-end (seed 42 C1 rho=-1.0, spread 0.095 at toy scale; overall FAIL is the 1-seed-vs-2-required scale artifact, not structural).
